verdict.rationale: Bento documents transactional email as its own message type, separate from broadcasts and sequences, and intended for receipts, password resets and order confirmations. Its CLI can send transactional emails. However, nothing in the evidence shows separate suppression handling, so there is no proof that a receipt reaches an unsubscribed contact. Nor does anything show isolated sending reputation or transactional-specific templates. missing for 10: documented bypass of marketing unsubscribes for transactional sends, separate suppression rules, separate sending reputation/IP/stream for transactional, transactional-specific templates, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an ops user, transactional email is kept separate from marketing — its own templates, suppression rules, and reputation — so a receipt still delivers to an unsubscribed contact

citations.quote: Transactional email is for messages a person needs because of an action, request, or account state: password resets, receipts, login codes, account notices, and order confirmations.
Bento handles three types: broadcasts for one-time campaigns, sequences for automated series, and transactional emails for individual notifications.
send transactional emails, manage templates, and more.
